 Order
. This matter is taken up through Hybrid arrangement (video conferencing/physical mode).
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

According to the learned counsel for the petitioner, the petitioner is aggrieved by inaction of the Opposite Parties in not paying the compensation for acquisition of his land under Land Acquisition Act, 1894 for construction of Lower Indra Irrigation Project, Khariar in the district of Nuapada.

He further submits that though the case of the petitioner has been recommended by Special Land Acquisition Officer, Lower Indra Irrigation Project, Khariar (Opposite Party No.3) to Director (R&R)
-cum- Ex-Officio, Additional Secretary to Government, Department of Water Resources, Odisha,
Bhubaneswar (Opposite Party No.2) on 11.09.2023 vide Annexure-3 for payment of higher compensation but till date nothing has been done in this matter.
In such background, he prays that a direction may be issued to the Opposite Party No.2 to take a decision on the recommendation of Opposite Party No.3 under Annexure-3 within a specific time period.

entities.text: Harekrushna Bhoi vs State Of Odisha And Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Considering such submissions made and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case,
this Court directs Opposite Party No.2 to take a decision on the recommendation of Opposite Party No.3 vide letter No.1327 dated 11.09.2023 in accordance with law within a period of three months from the date of receipt of a copy of this order and copy of the writ petition which will be produced by the petitioner and communicate the result of such exercise to the petitioner within two weeks of taking the decision.

In case Opposite Party No.2 finds claim of the petitioner legally acceptable, then he is directed to take all steps to release the compensation amount in favour of the petitioner within a period of four weeks thereafter.
The writ petition is, accordingly, disposed of.
Issue urgent certified copy as per Rules.

( S.K. Sahoo)
 Judge  (Chittaranjan Dash)
